Bill.BriefDescription: Establishing approval requirement for fluoridation of public water systems.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to fluoridation of public water systems; adding anew section to chapter 43.20 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that it is in thepublic interest that prior to the fluoridation of a public watersystem, the customers of the public water system or the customerelected local public water system governing body should make the finaldecision on the addition of fluoride to the public water system.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The addition of fluoridation compounds to water provided bypublic water systems not adding fluoridation compounds as of theeffective date of this act shall be permitted only upon an affirmativevote of: (a) The public water system's customers; or (b) The public water system's elected local governing body directlyresponsible to the public water system customers and to the departmentfor utility operations. p. 1 SB 5764 (2) As used in this section, "public water system" is defined asspecified in RCW 70.119.020.
